training_windows.rationale: Expanding window maximizes training data while maintaining temporal ordering

purge_rules.rationale: Purge must reference LABEL OUTCOME WINDOW, not feature boundary. A 10-day label requires 10-day purge.
purge_rules.implementation: For each prediction date t, exclude training observations where label period overlaps with t

embargo_rules.rationale: Additional buffer to prevent information leakage from label autocorrelation

label_outcome_boundaries.boundary_definition: Label computed using only data available after prediction date t

retraining_schedule.rationale: Confirmatory test fits one model per universe on full training data

evaluation_timestamps.rationale: IC computed monthly to assess temporal stability

purge_defect_prevention.phase_13b_issue: Phase 13B used feature boundary instead of label outcome window for purge
purge_defect_prevention.current_fix: Purge window explicitly set to label_horizon_days (10 days), not feature window
purge_defect_prevention.verification: Purge logic will be audited during execution
